text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Turbo. It's nothing<n>impressive, but
we planned a little<n>birthday party for you.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
For real?! Woohoo, a birthday party!<n>And Turbo's
the birthday girl!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
By the way, it'll be Ikuno's and my<n>birthday in a
few days too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Having multiple celebrations<n>clumped
together makes the occasion<n>all the more festive.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: So among us three, Turbo's birthday<n>comes first...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Uhh, it's totally gone to her head.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Okay, now I'm kinda annoyed, so I<n>say we call off
Turbo's birthday<n>party.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
With our birthdays coming up so<n>soon, we can
simply celebrate hers<n>then as well.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: No, no, no! You have to do it today!
